data.name: SoulForged:Ashborn
data.detailed_description:
Seoul has fallen. One year later, the forge burns again.

On April 20, 2040, the alien legion ARCHALIS descended on Seoul — and the city fell in a single day. One year later, the android girl ASH and the resistance ASHBORN rise from a hidden headquarters to take the city back, landmark by landmark. An anime-style hack-and-slash action RPG, rendered in cel shading inspired by Japanese animation.

Hack-and-Slash × Soulslike, in One Dungeon

Cut through waves of ARCHALIS in fast quarter-view hack-and-slash combat, then face pattern-driven boss duels built on parries, dodges, and counterattacks. Two combat grammars cross in a single dungeon.

Five Weapons, Your Build

Longsword, dagger, katana, greatsword, and laser blade — all five in your hands from the start of the campaign. Chain command-input combos, tune weapon mastery, and shape your favorite weapon into your own build. No boss ever forces a weapon choice.

Levelless, Research-Driven Growth

There is no XP bar. Strength comes from research and crafting: assign researchers and engineers at HQ, unlock technologies, and forge your gear. Every upgrade changes how the action feels.

The 30-Day Countdown

Terraforming advances while you fight. Manage the clock, or ARCHALIS will bring the war to you — headquarters defense battles put your people and resources on the line.

A Story Forged from Ash

A silent Professor, an android girl learning what it means to exist, and a resistance built from survivors — a story of trauma, memory, and forging yourself anew, set across Seoul's most iconic landmarks: DDP, Sebitseom, Namsan, Gwanghwamun, and COEX.
